children.text: Tooltip can be applied to focusable elements directly or to a wrapper that contains focusable children. In both cases, the tooltip will appear on hover and when the element receives focus.
Focusable element as target — the tooltip opens when the element itself is focused or hovered.
Wrapper with focusable children — the tooltip opens when any focusable child inside the wrapper receives focus, and stays open while focus moves between children.
